title: The Name Proclaimed: Merciful and Gracious
reflectionText: Yahweh proclaimed his own name to Moses: merciful and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving kindness and truth, forgiving iniquity — and by no means clearing the guilty. Moses hurried. He bowed to the ground and worshiped, and asked this God to go with a stiff-necked people anyway. What do you do with a God who is both merciful and just?
editorialNotes: PAL Daily supervised production 2026-07-26, Batch E. Exodus 34:1-10 ONLY. The proclaimed Name is rendered in full, keeping both halves the text holds together: 'merciful and gracious, slow to anger... forgiving iniquity' AND 'by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity... to the third and fourth generation' (34:6-7) — the difficult clause is not softened. Ends on the covenant promise of marvels (34:10). WEB uses 'Yahweh'. Narrator/mood/length were authoring selections (title/anchor owner-given) — flagged for owner review.
